title: L3Harris Sets Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
summary: L3Harris Technologies will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026.
body_markdown:
**MELBOURNE, Fla., Oct. 5, 2026** — L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026.


The company will then host an earnings call on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. ET. Participants are encouraged to listen via webcast at[L3Harris.com](http://www.l3harris.com/events/shareholder/third-quarter-calendar-2026-earnings-call) . A replay of the call will also be available on[L3Harris.com](http://www.l3harris.com/events/shareholder/third-quarter-calendar-2026-earnings-call) following the event.


**About L3Harris Technologies**


L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security. Visit[L3Harris.com](https://www.l3harris.com/) for more information.
